ErrorDiskNameInvalid: Disk names must begin with a letter or number, end with a letter, number or underscore, and may contain only letters, numbers, underscores, periods, or hyphens.
ErrorDiskNameTooLong: Disk names must be no more than 80 characters in length.
Title: Upload VHD
MainText: Select a VHD from which to create a disk and then specify the remaining parameters.
_SelectOptionGenerationV1.comment: The string 'V1' is literally the name of the generation, and is shorthand for 'Hyper-V Generation Version 1'.
_SelectOptionGenerationV2.comment: The string 'V2' is literally the name of the generation, and is shorthand for 'Hyper-V Generation Version 2'.
